title: World-mind network repair — fix the inert-weights shape bug the state-reading repair (learning is the successor plan)
source: operator direction 2026-08-05T02:47Z ('well we gotta fix it') on the inert-world-mind discovery from the checkpoint-loader S3 run
description: The world-mind's network has never produced a non-uniform policy: createWorldMind delegates to createNetwork which sizes W1 as [8][9] using the hive network's INPUT_SIZE (9), while encodeWorldState emits 8 features; forward reads input[8]===undefined, every hiddenPre becomes NaN, relu(NaN)->0, and logits collapse to zero-initialized b2 -> uniform [0.2 x5] for every seed and world state (measured: seeds 1 and 999999 identical; explains r6's uniform world-verb distribution). Fix the dimension binding so the network is sized by ITS OWN encoder's feature count, verify a live policy, and establish the new honest baseline.

overlap_disposition.owning_candidate: ant-world-checkpoint-loader (discovered the bug; world-mind.js in both write sets)
overlap_disposition.decision: new plan, sequenced AFTER the checkpoint-loader slice commits (S4 trial in flight)
overlap_disposition.stated_reason: The loader slice is behavior-preserving and evidence-complete; mixing a behavior-CHANGING repair into it would invalidate its A/A-prime equivalence evidence. Discovered-by is not owned-by. Sequencing: loader commits first; this repair applies on top; shape-hash change then correctly invalidates pre-repair checkpoints (forward-compat design already in the manifest).

tools/ant-hive-world/world-mind.js + untrained-network.js createNetwork/INPUT_SIZE — the mis-binding site

hard_constraints: Local sandbox only; no VM/orwell contact; no courier change
Lands AFTER the checkpoint-loader slice commits (world-mind.js conflict avoidance + evidence integrity)
Old checkpoints must REFUSE to load post-repair via the existing architecture/shape-hash validation — never load old weights into a re-shaped network
The dashboard/importer mirror derivations are unaffected structurally; only future BEHAVIOR changes

steps.title: Single-source the dimension binding
steps.description: Fix shape: the world-mind network's input dimension derives from its OWN encoder (encodeWorldState feature count, currently 8) — one source of truth, no shared INPUT_SIZE constant with the hive network. Audit createWorldMind/createNetwork/encodeWorldState for any other cross-bound dimension. Add an explicit construction-time assertion: encoder feature count === W1 column count, throw on mismatch (this bug becomes impossible to reintroduce silently).
files_touched: tools/ant-hive-world/untrained-network.js (only if createNetwork needs a dims parameter; otherwise untouched)

steps.title: Prove the mind is alive
steps.description: Prove the mind is alive — BOUNDED CRITERIA (codex r1): over a fixture of 1000 world states sampled from a seeded generator (fixture file + seed recorded in evidence): (a) ZERO NaN/Infinity anywhere in any forward pass; (b) SEED SENSITIVITY: policies from seed 1 vs seed 999999 on identical states differ by L2 distance > 0.01 on >= 90% of fixture states; (c) STATE SENSITIVITY: >= 100 distinct policy vectors (components compared at 1e-9 tolerance) across the fixture; (d) NON-DEGENERACY: mean per-state policy entropy < ln(5) - 0.05 (not stuck at uniform) AND > 0.1 (not collapsed to a delta); (e) weight-update path: if one exists, pre/post-run weight checksums differ over a 300-tick run; if NONE exists, report thinks-but-cannot-learn as the named successor gap. All thresholds are coordinator defaults, operator-overridable, recorded in evidence.

steps.title: New honest baseline + checkpoint invalidation proof
steps.description: New honest baseline + checkpoint invalidation proof — EXACT EVIDENCE CONTRACT (codex r1): mind-repair-evidence.json fields: {schema:'MindRepairEvidence/1.0', fixture:{path,seed,count}, liveness:{nan_count, seed_sensitivity:{threshold,pct_passing}, distinct_policies:{tolerance,count}, entropy:{mean,min,max}}, weight_update:{path_exists, pre_checksum, post_checksum} , baseline:{runs:[{run_id, root_seed, ticks, verb_distribution, applied_rate, entropy}], uniformity_test:{method:'chi-square vs uniform', statistic, p_value, verdict:'non-uniform requires p<0.001'}}, checkpoint_invalidation:{pre_repair_generation_id, pre_repair_arch_hash, post_repair_arch_hash, refusal_status:'must be resume-failed-halt:version:*', refusal_transcript_path}, overall_verdict}. The chi-square test (not sampled counts alone) is the liveness baseline standard. ALSO: refresh the stale row at state-inventory.md:97 (currently claims W1 [8][8]; record actual pre-repair [8][9] and post-repair [8][8]) with a dated correction note, never silent edit.

steps.title: Distinct trial + debrief
steps.description: Codex trial bound to the diff + evidence; findings per decision tree; debrief. Then the Orwell continuity control (owning plan) runs with a thinking mind — payload rebuild + G-REMOTE-MUTATION packet per the owning plan's gate.

Construction-time dimension assertion makes the bug class unreintroducible
